power.neoorigins.class_lumberjack_starti: Spawn pẹlu ohun Unbreaking II iron ake.
origins.neoorigins.class_blacksmith.name: Alagbẹdẹ
origins.neoorigins.class_blacksmith.desc: Olukọni titunto si ti ẹrọ rẹ jẹ didara ti o ga julọ ati pe atunṣe rẹ jẹ daradara siwaju sii.
power.neoorigins.class_blacksmith_repair: Awọn atunṣe anvil jẹ iye owo diẹ ati mimu-pada sipo agbara diẹ sii.
power.neoorigins.class_blacksmith_forge_: Ọwọ igboro fọ okuta bi agbẹ okuta.
Ngba ibajẹ idaji lati ina, lava, magma, ati sisun - awọ-ara ti o ni lile-lile.
power.neoorigins.class_blacksmith_starti: Spawn pẹlu awọn ingots irin 4 lati jẹ ki ayederu naa bẹrẹ.
origins.neoorigins.class_cook.name: Sise
origins.neoorigins.class_cook.descriptio: A Onje wiwa iwé ti o tiase ounje jẹ diẹ ounje ati awọn ti o jèrè ajeseku XP lati siga siga.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_food.name: Awọn ounjẹ to dara
power.neoorigins.class_cook_food.descrip: Ounjẹ ti o ṣiṣẹ pese ebi ajeseku ati itẹlọrun.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_seasoned_pal: Awọn ipa ipakokoro lori rẹ ṣiṣe ni 25% to gun.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_knife.name: Ọbẹ Cook
power.neoorigins.class_cook_knife.descri: Spawn pẹlu irin idà - gbogbo Cook nilo kan ti o dara abẹfẹlẹ.
origins.neoorigins.class_merchant.name: Onisowo
origins.neoorigins.class_merchant.descri: Oníṣòwò ọlọ́gbọ́n tí òwò àwọn ará abúlé rẹ̀ kì í tán lọ́wọ́, tí ó sì ń rí àwọn ọjà ṣọ́ọ̀ṣì lọ́wọ́ àwọn oníṣòwò tí ń rìn kiri.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_trades.d: Awọn iṣowo abule ko dinku fun ọ.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_rare_loo: Awọn oniṣowo alarinkiri fun ọ ni awọn iṣowo abule-ipele titunto si ati aye ni iṣura toje.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_starting: Spawn pẹlu emerald lati fun irugbin iṣowo akọkọ rẹ.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_silver_t: Awọn ipa ipakokoro lori rẹ ṣiṣe ni 15% to gun - alejò duro.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_lucky_tr: +1 Orire - ti o dara Fortune ri kan ti o dara haggler.
origins.neoorigins.class_cleric.name: Àlàyé
origins.neoorigins.class_cleric.descript: Ọmọwe mimọ kan pẹlu imudara awọn agbara iwunilori ati awọn akoko oogun ti o gbooro.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_enchanting: Enchanting tabili pese dara enchantments sunmọ ọ.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_potions.de: Gbogbo ipa ipa to lemeji bi gun.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_turn_undea: Deba on undead fi wọn Ailagbara fun 4 aaya.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_divine_sig: Ri diẹ sii kedere ni ina kekere - ẹbun lati oke.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_starting_b: Spawn pẹlu iwe kikọ fun awọn adura ati awọn akọsilẹ.
origins.neoorigins.class_nitwit.name: Nitwit
origins.neoorigins.class_nitwit.descript: Ko dara ni pataki ni ohunkohun. Nigba miiran ọna ti o rọrun julọ jẹ ọna ti o tọ.
origins.neoorigins.class_fisher.name: Apẹja
origins.neoorigins.class_fisher.descript: Life ni eti omi - fa orire lati awọn tides, we bi a asiwaju, ati ki o bẹrẹ pẹlu kan ibukun ọpá.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_waters_luc: +1 Oriire lakoko ti o wa ninu omi - ṣiṣan naa ṣe ojurere fun ọ.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_swim_speed: + 15% iyara gbigbe lakoko ti o wa ninu omi.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_sea_legs.d: Idaji drown bibajẹ - ẹdọforo saba si awọn jin.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_starting_r: Spawn pẹlu ọpá ipeja enchanted pẹlu Orire ti Òkun I ati Lure I.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_night_sigh: Awọn anfani Night Vision nigba ti labẹ omi.
origins.neoorigins.class_mason.name: Mason
origins.neoorigins.class_mason.descripti: Okuta Egbin ni lati niwa ọwọ - fi opin si awọn bulọọki yiyara, callused ọpẹ ihamọra ara, ati ki o kan gbe jẹ nigbagbogbo laarin arọwọto.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_stone_hands: Ọwọ igboro fọ okuta bi agbẹ okuta.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_strong_grip: + 1 ihamọra adayeba lati igbesi aye ti mimu ti a lo.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_stone_speed: Fi opin si ohun amorindun 25% yiyara.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_starting_pi: Spawn pẹlu ohun ṣiṣe ni mo okuta pickaxe.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_block_reach: +1 dena placement placement — a mason ká apa mọ ibi ti awọn odi dopin.
origins.neoorigins.class_paladin.name: Paladin
origins.neoorigins.class_paladin.descrip: Jagunjagun mimọ - undead falter ni ifọwọkan, gbigbẹ ko le di mu, ati ina ti ina kan mu awọn ọgbẹ larada.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_turn_unde: Deba on undead fi wọn Ailagbara fun 4 aaya.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_holy_armo: +2 ihamọra adayeba - ina ṣe aabo fun ọ.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_beacon_re: Laiyara atunbi lakoko laarin awọn bulọọki 8 ti tan ina kan.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_starting_: Spawn pẹlu Smite Mo irin idà.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_effect_im: Ajesara si Wither - arun na ko le fi ọwọ kan ọ.
origins.neoorigins.necromancer.name: Necromancer
origins.neoorigins.necromancer.descripti: Ọga ti iku ti o paṣẹ fun awọn minions undead — awọn egungun ti o gbẹ ati awọn tafàtafà ja ni ẹgbẹ rẹ, ṣugbọn agbara igbesi aye tirẹ ni owun si tiwọn.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_summon_with: Pe egungun ti o gbẹ lati ja fun ọ. Max 2 ni ẹẹkan. Awọn idiyele 6 koko. 30-keji itutu. O gba ibajẹ 1 ti o ba ku ni ija.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_summon_skel: Pe tafàtafà egungun kan lati ja fun ọ. Max 3 ni ẹẹkan. Awọn idiyele 4 koko. 20-keji itutu. O gba ibajẹ 1 ti o ba ku ni ija.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_entity_grou: Sọsọtọ bi undead. Ipalara nipasẹ Ilera Lẹsẹkẹsẹ, mu larada nipasẹ Bibajẹ Lẹsẹkẹsẹ, ajesara si Majele. Palara lati Smite.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_water_breat: Ko nilo lati simi. Le ye laelae labẹ omi.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_night_visio: Le ri kedere ni lapapọ òkunkun. Yipada pẹlu bọtini Iran Alẹ (aiyipada K).
power.neoorigins.necromancer_daylight_da: O gba ibajẹ 1.5 fun iṣẹju kan nigbati o farahan si imọlẹ orun taara.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_reduced_hea: -3 ọkàn (-6 max HP). Ara ti a fọ ​​nipasẹ idan iku.
Isọdọtun ilera adayeba ti dinku si 40% ti deede.
origins.neoorigins.gorgon.name: Gorgon
origins.neoorigins.gorgon.description: Ibanujẹ-awọ-okuta ti o ni oju rẹ ti o ni itara ati ti awọn ọwọ rẹ n fọ - ṣugbọn iwuwo okuta fa fifalẹ ni gbogbo igbesẹ.
Di gbogbo awọn ọta ti o wa nitosi pẹlu Slowness V. Awọn idiyele 3 agbara. 15-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_stone_fists.name: Okuta Fists
power.neoorigins.gorgon_stone_fists.desc: Awọn adehun 4 afikun bibajẹ fun buruju.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_granite_hide.des: Resistance Yẹ I - awọ okuta rọ gbogbo ipa.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_heavy_frame.name: Oniroyin
power.neoorigins.gorgon_size.name: Gbigbe Olopobobo
power.neoorigins.gorgon_hunger_drain.des: Burns stamina 50% yiyara - mimu fọọmu okuta jẹ sisan.
origins.neoorigins.automaton.name: Adaṣe
origins.neoorigins.automaton.description: A darí ikole ti ko drown tabi starves - sugbon iwosan potions fizzle, adayeba imularada ni glacial, ati gbogbo igbese ni eru.
power.neoorigins.automaton_iron_frame.de: Yẹ Resistance I — a ri to irin fireemu ko ni parun.
power.neoorigins.automaton_no_drown.name: edidi ẹnjini
power.neoorigins.automaton_no_drown.desc: Ko nilo lati simi. Ko le rì.
power.neoorigins.automaton_no_hunger.des: Ko jẹ ebi npa. Nṣiṣẹ lori orisun agbara inu.
power.neoorigins.automaton_hide_hunger_b: Ọpa ebi ti wa ni pamọ - awọn adaṣe ko jẹun.
Ọpa afẹfẹ ti wa ni pamọ - awọn adaṣe ko simi.
power.neoorigins.automaton_potion_resist: Ajesara si isọdọtun, Ilera Lẹsẹkẹsẹ, ati Majele. Awọn ipa oogun miiran tun wa.
Awọn sensọ opiti ti a ṣe sinu gba iran laaye ninu okunkun. Yipada pẹlu bọtini Iran Alẹ (aiyipada K).
power.neoorigins.automaton_heavy_chassis: Gbigbe 15% losokepupo - fireemu eru, awọn igbesẹ ti o wuwo.
Iwosan adayeba nṣiṣẹ ni oṣuwọn 25% - ti a ṣe lati farada, kii ṣe imularada.
origins.neoorigins.kraken.name: Kraken
origins.neoorigins.kraken.description: Apanirun ti o jinlẹ ti o jinlẹ ti a bi ni ita gbangba - omi apanirun pẹlu awọn lashes tentacle, awọn iyaworan inki, ati awọn alagbatọ ti a pe, ṣugbọn eti okun, sun-oorun, ti o gbẹ lori dada.
power.neoorigins.kraken_tentacle_lash.de: Ina kan boluti ojiji ti o fọju ati fa fifalẹ gbogbo awọn ọta ni rediosi-idina 6 kan. Awọn idiyele 2 koko. 6-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.kraken_ink_shot.name: Inki Shot
power.neoorigins.kraken_ink_shot.descrip: Ina kan boluti ti ogidi inki ti o darale fa fifalẹ awọn ọta ni a 5-Àkọsílẹ rediosi. Awọn idiyele 2 koko. 8-keji itutu.
Nmi labẹ omi lainidi ati rii ni kedere nipasẹ omi laisi kurukuru.
